# Univariate latent-input model

This reusable engine handles one latent continuous input represented by one
ordinal proxy, together with any number of numeric predictors. Study I is one
configured use of this model; the fitting and prediction code itself is not
study-specific.

```{r copy-study1-engine, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts",
  "model_univariate.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```
